text:
noah: FYI - Partner NimbusCloud submitted invoice NC-2026-06 with a weird tier billing issue. Their CSV assigns our customer C-445 to "enterprise" tier for metered SKUs for June, but our mapping shows them as "starter". Reported billed amount is ~ $9.6k higher than expected. Can partner-finance confirm export?

priya: I ran our reconciliation. Units line up but the unit price used in their export is enterprise_rate ($0.12) vs our starter_rate ($0.03) for metered sku MTR-01. Snapshot: units=80,000, partner_billed=$9,600, expected=$2,400.

mike: Partner says they applied a global price tier override during a bulk migration on 2026-06-15 and missed excluding metered SKUs. They propose issuing a corrected invoice and credit for the delta. ETA 3 business days.

noah: Given month close tomorrow, we need to avoid overstating revenue. Recommend posting a provisional contra-revenue JV for $7,200 (difference) with GL 4-150 "Reseller Tier Corrections" pending partner CM. Any objections?

priya: Agree. Also tag customer C-445 ledger so downstream AR isn't impacted. Add note to month-end pack referencing partner migration id MIG-9876.

partner-finance: NimbusCloud confirms they'll send corrected invoice NC-2026-06-R and a credit memo CN-762 within 3 business days. They apologized and will add the export job id and missing exclusion filter to the RCA.

billing-bot: Provisional JV created: JV-2026-0750, amount $7,200, GL 4-150, status:PENDING_REVERSAL, ticket:FIN-4745.

mike: Also filing an infra request to add a pre-ingest guardrail for partner tier overrides: block bulk tier changes that affect metered SKUs without explicit opt-in. INFRA-7848 opened.

noah: Draft partner message (for records):

"Subject: NC-2026-06 - provisional adjustment posted"

"Hi NimbusCloud team,

Thanks for the update. We've posted a provisional adjustment (JV-2026-0750) pending your corrected invoice and credit memo (NC-2026-06-R / CN-762). Please send PDFs to billing@redwood.ai. Once received we'll reverse the provisional JV and reconcile.

Best,
Noah (Finance)"

priya: Adding to month-close pack and marking NC-2026-06 revenue hold. Leave thread open until CM attached to FIN-4745.
